for(i in 1:npops){
pop <- subset(plant_data, populationID == popsID[i])

# Standardized traits
z <- scale(data.frame(zcrop = pop$fruit_crop, zdiam = pop$xDiam))

# Fitness (number of pecked fruits)
W <- pop$pecked_fruits

# Fitness function
trait_fitness <- na.omit(data.frame(z, W))
k <- round((1/4)*nrow(trait_fitness), 0) # k = 1/4 of sample size
ff <- gam(W ~ s(zcrop) + s(zdiam),
          family = nb(), data = trait_fitness)

# Selection gradients 
sel.grads <- gam.gradients(mod = ff, 
                       phenotype = c("zcrop", "zdiam"), 
              covariates = NULL, standardized = TRUE, 
              se.method = "boot.para", n.boot = 1000, 
              parallel = "no", ncpus = 1, refit.smooth = FALSE)

estimates_grads[[i]] <- sel.grads$ests
}
